gaps.where: Settings → Calendars: the link under each calendar and its copy icon; a calendar's Booking link card (Copy, Open, Preview booking page); Settings → Calendars → Booking site, the address at the top with Copy and Open
gaps.gap: The screens show and copy origin + path, where origin is the business's own domain once it is serving, otherwise the app's own (https://app.handsfreeos.com). The Assistant only ever gets the path. get_settings (calendars) returns calendar.list's bookingPath (/book/<site>/<cal>) and permanentPath (/book/c/<id>). get_settings (booking_site) returns site.path (/book/<slug>). get_calendar_settings returns no link at all. Nothing in the prompt, the context or any tool gives the app origin. get_settings (branded_domain) gives the branded domain but not the fallback, so a business with no domain of its own can't get a correct full link.
gaps.fix: In apps/worker/src/assistant/tools-settings.ts, give the `calendars` and `booking_site` AreaQuery entries a shape. It adds bookingUrl = origin + (bookingPath ?? permanentPath) to each calendar and url = origin + path to the site. Work out the origin the way send_form does (tools-forms.ts:382-388): branded_domain.get as the person, `https://<domain>` when status is verified and certificateReady, else webUrl. send_form uses that query, not publicOrigin. ReadTool (tools-read.ts:224) takes no webUrl, and createToolExecutor.run calls settingsReadTools with (db, ctx, args) only (tools-write.ts:886-893), so thread webUrl into that call. Add the same bookingUrl to get_calendar_settings' calendar block (apps/worker/src/assistant/tools-scheduling.ts:448-455); calendar.get already carries bookingPath and permanentPath.

gaps.where: Every booking link the Assistant writes
gaps.gap: Real: the fixed prompt's link example is https://handsfreeos.com/book/acme (prompt.ts:49). That is the marketing site's domain, and it has no /book redirect (apps/site/next.config.ts:11-31 only redirects /login, /sign-in, /sign-up and /delete-account), so the link 404s. With only a path in hand (cal-1), the model completes it with that domain. Not a gap: "instead of handsfreeos.com" in settings-map.ts:141 and tools-setup.ts:244, and the manage_web_address card and outcome words at tools-setup.ts:1747/1797/1842. They repeat the screen's own wording in branded-domain-card.tsx:182,210,274,281, so changing only the Assistant's copy would make it describe the screen differently from what it says.
gaps.fix: In apps/worker/src/assistant/prompt.ts:49, change the example to one that isn't a HandsFreeOS domain, e.g. https://go.acme.com/book/acme. Add one rule: "Never build a link from a path. Give the full link a tool returned, or say where to copy it (Settings → Calendars, the copy icon beside it)." Leave settings-map.ts:141 and tools-setup.ts as they are, unless branded-domain-card.tsx changes too.

gaps.where: Settings → Calendars → New calendar: How do you want this calendar to work? (Personal, Round Robin, Service, Group/Class, Event, Webinar, Resource, Collective, Dispatch, Start from scratch), Who takes turns?, Which services?, What does each booking reserve?
gaps.gap: manage_calendar create calls calendar.create with no preset, so the schema default 'scratch' applies (schemas/calendar.ts:125). configFromPreset('scratch') puts nobody on the calendar, not even the creator (presets.ts:146-148), and adds services and resources only for the service and resource presets (presets.ts:167-176). The worker then strips teammates, services and resources from the follow-up patch (tools-settings-calendar.ts:318-323). The card lists "Who works it" and "What it offers", yet the calendar is created with nobody, no services and no resources. There is no preset input, so Group/Class, Event, Webinar, Collective and Dispatch calendars can't be made as the screen makes them. The outcome "X is set up" never says it starts as a draft, which the screen's toast does. The worker test at assistant-settings.test.ts:252-280 checks neither the members nor the status.
gaps.fix: Add preset: z.enum(PRESET_KEYS) to manage_calendar (packages/core/src/assistant/tools.ts:373-399) and pass it to calendar.create. Stop stripping teammates, services and resources at tools-settings-calendar.ts:318-323. After create, save team.members, services {mode, items} and resources.required through saveConfig. End the outcome with "It starts as a draft; say turn it on when it’s ready." Extend assistant-settings.test.ts:252 to assert memberIds contains owner.id and status is 'draft'.

gaps.where: A calendar → Resources: Add a resource, the How many stepper, Remove
gaps.gap: calendarPatch sends { resources: { items: [...] } }, but the config key is resources.required. mergePatch adds an `items` key, and CalendarConfig.parse strips it (a non-strict zod object), so resources.required never changes. The card shows "What it needs: Truck 2" and the outcome says "is changed", yet nothing is saved. On create the resources are also stripped and ignored (see cal-3). Quantity is always 1, while the screen has a How many stepper (1–100) for each resource.
gaps.fix: In apps/worker/src/assistant/tools-settings-calendar.ts:155-157, patch { resources: { required: [{ resourceId, quantity }] } }. Change manage_calendar.resources (tools.ts:383) to [{ resourceId, quantity: z.int().min(1).max(100).default(1) }], as manage_service does at tools.ts:425-433. Dry-run the save for the card as update_calendar_settings does (tools-scheduling.ts:2097), so an unsaved change can't show as done.

gaps.where: A calendar's settings: Team & assignment, Services & lengths, Availability (Calendar hours), Resources, Buffers & travel, Booking window, Calendar connections, and the Online place's video link
gaps.gap: Already covered: get_settings (calendars) returns calendar.list's memberIds, color, description, labels and timezone (queries/calendar.ts:126-145). The per-turn context gives, for the first 8 calendars only, the assignment mode, people's names and services (context.ts:298-316, prompt.ts:235-251). get_calendar_settings gives Open hours/Fixed sessions as 'books'. Really missing in every tool: crew size, each member's weight, order and must-go, the services mode, lengths, customer-picks-length and start-time step, calendar hours, buffers and travel time, minimum notice, days ahead, the only-between dates, the daily limit, the resources it needs and how many, the two calendar-connection switches, each Online place's video provider and recording, and whether the time zone is its own or the business's (ownTimezone). manage_calendar says "Read it with get_settings first", but that read holds none of these.
